token.common: Use case: stylized-concept. Production BOARD TOKEN for Pawnshire, a 2D storybook animal chess game. Supplied image is ONLY a style/proportion/base/outline reference. Do NOT copy mouse species or pawn headgear unless this request is pawn. Draw ONE centered compact chess-piece BUST: a big animal head and tiny shoulders directly on a short wide round plinth. About as wide as tall. Whole headgear and base visible with 8% empty margin. Three-quarter front view facing slightly right. Match reference's thick warm dark ink outlines, flat matte colour, one simple soft shade, very simple shapes, no painterly grain or fine detail; must read at 45px. Creature wears dark olive/charcoal highway bandit cloak and small brown leather neck tie. Creature's natural face remains fully visible, recognizable and expressive. No body, limbs, weapons, scenery, letters, borders, cast shadow, gradient or floor. Flat perfectly solid MAGENTA #FF00FF background edge to edge. CRITICAL COLOR KEY: ALL chess headgear and the ENTIRE round base/plinth are painted vivid PURE CYAN #00FFFF with simple cyan shading and dark ink edges. The animal fur, feathers, eyes, mask, cloak and accessories must have NO cyan, blue or teal; only warm natural browns, greys, olive, cream and amber. No gems or separate gold metal hardware on the headgear or base. This is a cyan-key master for deterministic ivory/ebony recolouring, not a finished colour sprite.

subjects.pawn: a RACCOON pawn, unmistakeable broad raccoon face with grey-brown fur, black NATURAL raccoon eye mask, small round ears, bright dark eyes and short snout. No cloth face covering. Mischievous calculating smile. Its helmet is a large smooth ROUND DOMED helmet like the ball top of a chess pawn: no flat top, crest or point.
subjects.knight: a HARE knight, unmistakable tawny hare face with white muzzle and two long upright rabbit ears visible behind the headgear. Small dark cloth eye-mask around the eyes, never hiding the muzzle. Its headgear is a large HELMET SHAPED LIKE A HORSE HEAD, the same classic knight chess silhouette used on the frog knight. Horse face belongs ONLY to helmet, hare face clearly visible BELOW helmet; long ears angle modestly behind so they do not overwhelm horse-head silhouette. Compact alert face.
subjects.bishop: a MAGPIE bishop, unmistakeable black and white magpie head and long straight pointed beak. Charcoal cloth band around eyes, leaving white cheek markings and beak visible. Its chess headgear is a TALL POINTED MITRE with ONE clearly visible DIAGONAL SLIT in the front, the classic chess bishop shape. Amber eye, calculating calm.
subjects.rook: a BADGER rook, unmistakeable stocky grey-brown badger face with bold black and cream longitudinal face stripes, short rounded ears and blunt black nose. Charcoal cloth eye-mask small enough to keep stripes visible. Its headgear is a SHORT WIDE CASTLE TOWER with THREE LARGE SQUARE CRENELLATIONS, the unmistakable chess rook silhouette; tower sits behind/above head like a compact tower helmet, face protrudes below it. No pointed ears, crown or mitre. Sturdy heavy-luggage carrier.
subjects.queen: a STOAT queen, unmistakable slim warm cinnamon-brown stoat face with cream chin and throat, small round ears, narrow elongated muzzle and bright black eyes; NOT a fox, wolf, raccoon or cat, no pointed fox ears, no mane. Small charcoal cloth eye-mask around eyes, muzzle visible. Its chess headgear is a broad TALL SPIKED CORONET with FIVE SHARP POINTS, unmistakable chess QUEEN crown, absolutely NO CROSS. Confident clever expression.
subjects.king: ASHFANG the wolf king, unmistakeable mature GREY WOLF face with pointed wolf ears, long wolf muzzle and thick grey-brown cheek ruff; NOT lion, no round mane. A small charcoal highwayman's eye-mask leaves his face visible. Its headgear is a TALL ROYAL CROWN TOPPED WITH ONE CLEAR LARGE CROSS, the unmistakable chess KING crown. Smooth calculating half-smile and amber eyes, dignified bandit lord, not snarling. Crown cross fully visible.

portraits.common: Use case: stylized-concept. Production detailed character FIGURINE used for a talking-head portrait in Pawnshire, a 2D animal chess storybook. Reference 1 is the character's own board token: preserve its species, face/markings, mask, dark olive cloak, brown leather neck tie and headgear shape. Reference 2 is the existing ally figurine: match ONLY its fine warm ink outlines, muted painted watercolor/gouache texture, material rendering, full-body pose and compact large-headed proportions, NOT its species, colours or faction outfit. A detailed painted illustration, NOT a flat vector enlargement of the token, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D. ONE entire compact full-body figurine on a round dark wooden plinth with a worn bronze rim, complete headgear, feet, base and any prop visible with empty margin. Tall composition, three-quarter front view, face large and readable in a portrait crop. All background genuinely transparent, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no frame. Natural brown/grey/cream animal colours. Dark olive and charcoal highwayman's cloak, worn brown leather belts, restrained bronze fittings. Headgear is worn DARK IRON with warm grey highlights, never cyan. Maintain the exact same creature identity as reference1; expressive gentle storybook character, never sinister horror.

subjects.pawn: A RACCOON PAWN highway thief with grey-brown fur, natural black raccoon eye-mask (no cloth mask), a round DOMED dark iron pawn helmet. A confident sly smile. Wears dark olive cloak over brown leather tunic, holds a short walking staff in one paw and a small leather coin purse in the other. Ringed raccoon tail modestly visible behind body. No weapons pointed at viewer.
subjects.knight: A HARE KNIGHT highway rider with tawny fur, cream muzzle and two long hare ears visible behind a dark iron HORSE-HEAD-SHAPED knight helmet. Small charcoal cloth eye-mask, bright amber-brown eyes, dark olive cloak and leather traveling jerkin. Alert cheeky expression. Holds one plain short lance upright, other paw resting at belt; no actual mount. Hare's own face must remain fully visible below horse helmet. Long hare feet.
subjects.bishop: A MAGPIE BISHOP roadside lookout with black/white feathers, white cheek/throat patch and long straight black beak. Small charcoal cloth band around eyes, amber eye. Wears a tall dark iron bishop MITRE with a clear diagonal SLIT. Dark olive cloak and brown leather tie. Hushed knowing expression. Stands upright on bird feet, holds a slim wooden road staff with one tiny amber bead (not a glow). Magpie, not crow/owl.
subjects.rook: A BADGER ROOK with stout grey-brown badger body, black/cream lengthwise face stripes and short round ears, small charcoal cloth eye-mask. Wears a dark olive cloak and brown tie, sturdy brown leather travel gear. A compact short broad CASTLE TOWER with THREE square crenellations, worn warm dark-grey iron/stone, forms a tower helmet/backpack just above and behind his face; the tower is the rook chess cue and is not a crown. Upright sturdy stance, paws clasped at belly, no weapon. Patient heavy-luggage porter expression.
subjects.queen: A STOAT QUEEN, slim cinnamon-brown stoat body, cream chin/throat, small ROUND ears, narrow elongated muzzle, black eyes and charcoal cloth eye-mask; no pointed fox ears, no mane. Dark olive cloak over a fitted traveling gown with brown leather belt and neck tie. Wears a tall DARK IRON queen coronet with FIVE CLEAN SHARP TRIANGULAR SPIKES, no round ball finials and absolutely NO cross. Holds a slender wooden staff in one paw and rests the other at belt; long slender tail curves quietly behind, black tip. Clever confident half-smile.
subjects.king: ASHFANG, the WOLF KING and Bandit Lord: mature grey-brown wolf with pointed ears, long wolf muzzle, thick cheek ruff (NOT round lion mane), amber eyes and charcoal cloth highwayman's eye-mask. Dark olive lord's cloak with brown neck tie over dark leather coat and belt, modest bronze trim. Wears a lobed dark iron king CROWN TOPPED WITH A LARGE CLEAR CROSS, matching token silhouette. Upright commanding pose, one paw resting on a plain wooden walking sceptre and the other holding a single small leather coin pouch. Smooth calculating amused expression, no snarl, no fangs bared.

tadwell.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production detailed story character figurine for Pawnshire, same painted ink-and-watercolour/gouache style, muted natural palette and proportions as reference. The reference is SIR HOB, a different frog knight: use ONLY its species, traditional horse-head knight helmet, illustration style, and round wooden base as shared world vocabulary. Create TADWELL, THE FROG CAPTAIN: a distinctly different mature broad-faced olive-green frog, heavier brow, calm dutiful expression, very upright formal stance, closed mouth, no cheeky grin. He wears a polished warm-grey STEEL horse-head-shaped knight helmet, pushed up so full broad frog face shows. Cream old-army tabard with restrained gold trim and small gold crest, dark burgundy short captain's cape, leather belt, steel gorget. No eye mask, no bandit costume, no teal tunic like Sir Hob. He holds a neatly rolled cream-and-gold army banner under one arm and rests the other hand on a plain upright short lance, dutiful military bearing, not aggressive. No letters or text on banner. ONE compact full-body figurine on a dark wooden round plinth with gold/bronze rim, all helmet, feet, lance and base visible with 8% empty margin. Detailed softly painted material and warm ink outlines like existing figurine, not 3D, not photorealistic, not flat vector. Tall composition. Genuinely transparent background, no scenery, no floor/shadow, no frame, no other figures. Face and helmet large enough for a tall talking-head crop. This is a travelling story ally, not a new board-token species.

map.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production map-region2 painted landscape for Pawnshire, a 2D storybook chess journey. Reference image is ONLY for the established world's pen-and-ink illustration, soft textured painted fills, muted olive/plum/leather palette, elevated oblique map perspective and restrained contrast. Create the KINGSROAD, a distinct new road-and-woodland chapter, not a swamp. A full-bleed landscape scene, wide 4:3 aspect: a winding warm dirt-and-cobblestone kingsroad threads through rolling olive hills, copses of old trees, a shallow stream with stone/wood bridges, a small timber village at a crossroads near one edge, an old roadside inn with a broken wagon wheel leaning beside its door near another edge, and a discreet highway bandit toll camp with dark olive tents by a timber gate on the far road. Warm late-afternoon amber light, quiet adventurous storybook mood, worn red/gold army banners folded near the toll camp. Most of the central image is calm open grassy ground and broad road bends, leaving negative space for six large UI lesson stops; details belong toward the edges and corners. Interesting scenery distributed across the image so it can crop on a phone. Hand-inked contours, matte painted textures, soft muted low contrast, dark warm browns, sage/olive greens and limited plum accents. No text, letters, town labels, signs with writing, chessboard, chess pieces, interface, path markers, circles, icons, ornate frame, border, photorealism, 3D, sharp neon, or characters. Edge-to-edge scene. Do not copy the swamp pools, goblins or exact composition of the reference.

corrections.instruction: Remove all round ball finials from the five crown points; keep five clean sharp triangular spikes. Keep all other token details unchanged.
Replace only the bushy fox-like tail with a slim short-haired stoat tail with a black final third. Keep all other figurine details unchanged.
